About us

We provide high quality and productive services by keeping a tab on the international standards and technology and in compliance with the mechanical systems, feasibility, consultancy, material supply, application, operating and management regulations on Heating-Cooling, Ventilation and Air Conditioning, Fire Fighting, Plumbing, Building Mechanical Automation and so on.
